42 Step into My Story
Empothy
Every day in school, your friends feel different feelings: happy, sad, left out,
proud or even embarrassed. Sometimes, we do not notice or we do not know
what to say. But when we take a moment to think about how they might be
feeling, we start building empathy.
These are some ways in which you know you have empathy :
